---
title: "Locations to GeoJSON"
format:
  html:
    df-print: kable
---

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(sf)
loc_df <- read_csv("geocoded.csv")
loc_df <- loc_df |>
  drop_na(latitude, longitude)
loc_df |> head()
```

```{r}
loc_sf <- st_as_sf(
  loc_df,
  coords = c("longitude","latitude")
)
st_write(loc_sf, "geocoded.geojson")
```
